text:
maya: quick heads-up — i'm trying a runtime 'rate estimator' to turn request shape (batch size, dims) into an expected token-cost estimate per-req so console can show cost-before-send :eyes:

sam: do you mean per-embedding request cost or per-tenant budget enforcement?

maya: both. ui needs a preview (estimate only). infra needs a soft quota that can reject/route when predicted cost > budget. not hard enforcement at start.

dana: sounds useful. main risk is estimator drift vs actual runtime (quantized models + batching can change token cost nonlinearly). what inputs are you using?

maya: plan: shape: embeddings.length, avg_chars, dims header if provided. also model variant and route (hosted/dedicated). baseline kernels. heuristic: base_cost = dims * 0.000002 + per_vector_overhead. then factor for batching efficiency at >N.

leo: two asks: 1) telemetry hooks to record predicted_cost vs actual_cost at request completion; 2) a sampling tag so we can store full traces for mismatches >20%.

maya: agree. i'll add telemetry keys: embed.predicted_cost, embed.actual_cpu_ms, embed.kv_cache_hits, embed.model_variant. ingest-bot: sample traces at 1% by default and 10% for mismatches.

ingest-bot: automated message: sampling policy updated (1% global, 10% for mismatch>20%). :robot_face:

sam: console UX: show "estimated cost" in compose and an inline hint "estimates may differ; actual billed units shown after completion". need copy review from product.

claire: rollout plan: start with console preview opt-in flag in account settings + infra soft-fail toggle. canary to 5% tenants flagged for high-volume to avoid noise.

maya: question: how to handle mixed-dim batches? i.e., client sends 3x128, 2x1024 in same payload. estimator could sum per-vector predicted cost but routing may split into separate jobs causing different batching efficiency. thoughts?

dana: approx approach: compute per-dim base cost, then apply a coalescing discount factor per-shard computed from historical coalescence matrix. basically we track P(coalesced_with_X) from telemetry and reduce estimate accordingly.

leo: that matrix is heavy. maybe coarse bucketing: small (<=256), medium (257-1024), large (>1024) dims. compute coalesce_discount(bucket_from, bucket_to). much simpler and still effective.

maya: agreed. keep sigmoid smoothing and LRU for recent window. also expose a header so SDKs can opt into "embed-estimate: true" to get server-side more accurate accounting (we'll return an estimate id). example response header: `X-Embed-Estimate-Id: eid_abc123`

sam: if we return estimate id we can correlate after completion and surface delta in console. good. store estimates in telemetry index with ttl 7d.

claire: quota UX: show "predicted usage" vs quota in dashboard but don't count against quota until we actually bill. maybe a separate "preview usage" meter. ops/biz should sign off.

dana: important: estimator should never be used to silently drop traffic. soft-fail only: return 412 with recommendation and reason string when tenant has soft-quota and predicted > threshold. body: `{"error":"embed_quota_preview","reason":"estimated_units_exceed_budget"}`

leo: implement a per-tenant threshold policy: warn_at=80%, softreject_at=110%. softreject returns 412 + X-Embed-Estimate-Id so SDK can surface prompt and allow override.

maya: telemetry event example (proto):
```
embed.estimate {
  id: "eid_..."
  tenant: "acct_123"
  predicted_units: 12.4
  actual_units: 11.9
  dims: [128,1024,128]
  route: "hosted"
}
```

sam: logging should avoid PII — ensure vectors not stored, only dims/lengths/masks.

dana: also track split decisions: `splitter: split_count=2 reason=max_payload` so we can debug 413/413-like behaviors.

ingest-bot: automated alert: embed.estimate mismatch rate > 15% for route hosted in us-west-2.

maya: ugh. that's from yesterday's model change — quantization lowered compute for 1024 dims by ~30%. need a retrain of heuristic.

claire: action items: maya update estimator to include model_quant_factor; leo add telemetry sampling and correlation; sam wire console preview + copy; dana add soft-reject responses and split logging; ops monitor mismatch rate and schedule policy revert if mismatch > 25% for >1h. I'll own the rollout doc. :thumbsup: 

sam: can we get a simple dashboard tile in console to show predicted_vs_actual by tenant for last 24h? would help biz signoff.

leo: will add a per-tenant graph (predicted, actual, delta) and a heatmap for dims buckets. low priority but 2-week sprint candidate.

maya: thanks all. i'll open a PR for estimator code + telemetry schema. linking soon. :seedling:

sam: ping when PR is up, will run perf bench locally.

claire: leaving notes for product review: include wording on "estimate accuracy" and an education tooltip.

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4822 (WIP)

leo: looked. small nit in metric naming (use embed.actual_units not embed.cpu_ms). will comment.

maya: updated. closing the loop tomorrow after a small canary.

ingest-bot: automated message: thread archived after 6 days of inactivity.
